SELECT

FROM cohort

# Q3 2026 Performance Review & Q4 Action Plan

## Executive summary
- Net revenue for your products reached $398,405.73 in Q3 2026, representing a 26.2% increase from Q2 2026 ($315,617.28) and an 85.3% surge compared to Q3 2025 ($214,959.77).
- Growth was powered primarily by strong new customer acquisition, which accounted for 58.6% ($233,612.79) of total net revenue in the quarter.
- Intimates, Outerwear & Coats, and Jeans led category performance, while Skirts and Blazers & Jackets experienced the highest return rates.

## Key findings
- **Revenue and Order Growth**: Q3 2026 net revenue grew to $398,405.73 across 5,123 orders and 4,693 active buying customers. Average order value (AOV) remained stable at $77.77 (compared to $78.90 in Q2 2026 and $79.44 in Q3 2025).
- **Customer Acquisition Mix**: New customers drove $233,612.79 across 2,703 buying customers (2,985 orders), while returning customers generated $164,792.94 across 1,990 buying customers (2,138 orders).
- **Category Leaders**: Intimates was the top revenue category at $39881.11, followed by Outerwear & Coats ($37,217.15) and Jeans ($35,035.23). All categories registered strong year-over-year revenue gains compared to Q3 2025.
- **Return Rates**: Skirts recorded the highest return rate at 12.8% (203 items sold), followed by Blazers & Jackets at 12.1% (365 items sold) and Leggings at 12.0% (367 items sold).
- **Acquisition Channels**: Search remained the dominant traffic source, delivering $278,868.16 across 3,288 buying customers, far outpacing Organic ($56,776.68) and Facebook ($27,856.54).

## Why it happened
- **Driver breakdown**: The 26.2% quarter-over-quarter revenue increase was driven by a 28.1% rise in order volume (5,123 orders in Q3 vs. 4,000 in Q2) and a 24.1% increase in active buyers (4,693 vs. 3,782), while AOV remained flat (-1.4%).
- **Channel concentration**: Search traffic generated 70.0% of total net revenue, indicating a high reliance on paid or organic search engines for top-of-funnel acquisition.
- **Return patterns**: Fitted categories like Skirts, Blazers & Jackets, and Leggings continue to face double-digit return rates, pointing to potential sizing or fit description challenges on product pages. *(Hypothesis to verify: customer reviews and size guide usage).*

## Action items

| Action | Owner | Priority | Expected impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Refine size guides and fit descriptions** for Skirts, Blazers & Jackets, and Leggings to reduce return rates currently exceeding 12.0%. | Merchandising | High | Moderate reduction in returns for high-return categories, improving net margins. |
| **Scale paid search and SEO campaigns** heading into Q4, given Search's position as the primary revenue driver ($278.8K in Q3). | Marketing | High | Increased top-of-funnel traffic and order volume during peak holiday shopping. |
| **Launch targeted retention and loyalty promotions** for the 1,990 returning customers to increase their repeat order frequency ahead of Q4. | CRM / Marketing | Medium | Higher repeat purchase rate and increased share of wallet from existing buyers. |
| **Expand inventory depth** on top-performing Q3 categories (Intimates, Outerwear & Coats, and Jeans) to prevent stockouts in Q4. | Supply Chain / Merchandising | High | Maximized revenue capture during peak seasonal demand. |
